toolprompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: horizontal character turnaround sheet for a game art reference
Input image 1 is the approved Fine character design and the only visual reference. Preserve Fine exactly: 22-year-old adult mountain-village gatherer, honey-colored loose wavy long hair, kind drooping eyes and relaxed older-sister smile, rustic cream blouse and green bodice/apron with long skirt, blue-gray sash, brown belt and pouch, large woven backpack basket with medicinal herbs, sturdy brown lace-up boots, colors and bold simple anime-manga cel style.
Create one wide horizontal sheet with exactly THREE full-body drawings of the same Fine, equally spaced left to right, identical scale, same head-top and foot-bottom baseline:
1) FRONT: strict 0-degree front-facing neutral standing view.
2) SIDE: strict 90-degree true side profile facing RIGHT; nose, chest and toes point right, back of head left. No three-quarter.
3) BACK: strict 180-degree rear view.
Neutral turnaround pose: arms slightly away from torso and naturally lowered, hands relaxed, feet parallel, no dramatic action pose or exaggerated T-pose. Keep the large basket's shoulder straps and position physically consistent; the basket sits on her back behind her hair, with a modest herb bundle visible where physically plausible. Rotate belt pouch and sash consistently. Long hair keeps its length and falls naturally down the back. Back view adds only the logical continuation of the rustic clothes and basket straps, no invented decoration or equipment. Full hair and feet visible, identical scale and baseline, generous spacing.
Background: flat white to warm ivory, no perspective, no dramatic light, no large ground shadows. Add only small English labels FRONT, SIDE, BACK below the figures. No other text, no name, no watermark.
Avoid: any 3/4 angle, mirrored side direction, extra figures, child/chibi proportions, making Fine elderly or motherly, moving the basket to the front, new weapons, cropped head or feet.
